data.gender_notes: Labis is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘labas’, meaning fresh water spring. This name is evocative of the natural world and the beauty of creation. The name Labis carries the meaning “Fresh water spring” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, English. Parents who choose Labis usually hope their child will grow to embody fresh water spring and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the freshness and purity of faith, as well as the nourishing and life-giving properties of sacred knowledge.
data.etymology: Labis belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Fresh water spring.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Labis total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_urdu.name: لبيس
in_urdu.meaning: وہ جو لباس پہنتا ہے یا اپنے جسم کو ڈھانپتا ہے

in_english.name: Labis
in_english.meaning: One who wears clothes or covers his body
in_english.long_meaning: Labis is one of the beautiful names of Allah, and it means one who wears clothes or covers his body. This name reflects the attributes that Allah grants to His servants, such as clothing and protection. In Islamic tradition, Labis signifies the provider of garments, both material and spiritual, and represents the aspect of Allah that clothes His creation in the world and the hereafter.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Labis" has cultural significance in various Muslim communities where the naming of a child is tied to Islamic traditions. One such cultural belief is the importance of a unique and beautiful name for a child. The name "Labis" represents not only a connection to nature but also a nod to the rich Islamic literary tradition which abundantly uses metaphors and symbolism. In the Quran, water is often used as a symbol of purity, life, and renewal. Thus, this name is a constant reminder of the beauty of nature and the blessings of fresh water for life.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Labis" holds spiritual significance as it is reminiscent of the critical role of water in our faith. In Islamic tradition, water symbolizes life, purity, and renewal. By giving the name "Labis," parents are reminding their child of the nurturing power of Allah, the sustainer of life. "Labis," therefore, is a constant reminder of the blessings of the natural world, a testament to Allah's mercy, and an invitation to appreciate its beauty and importance. This spiritual significance encourages individuals to develop a deep sense of gratitude and appreciation for the gift of life and the blessings that come with it.
